verdicts.note: Doc cite :60 only covers vendor/ceedling; the relative-path sentence is which-ceedling.md:78-81.
Claim omits the fallback to unresolved @root when realpath fails.
The ~ line in results.txt is a sed rewrite of the real $HOME path.
The subdirectory is the source file's own directory; a source dir named c would give out/c.
Doc lines 80-87 only loosely support the claim; code supports it fully.
Behaviour holds. Cited evidence file results_include_min.txt does not hold the runner head, and no script creates project.runner.yml or include/sub/missing.h.

Core right. ':paths :test and :source directories are not on it' holds only when the test directory has no header; a :test directory holding a header is added. Real list also holds TEST_INCLUDE_PATH, :support, :libraries and test-toolchain include entries.
Output paths right (build/test/out/<test>/_t_/ not build/tests/out). 'Test directories are not -I entries' is overstated: a :test directory holding headers is on -I.
'Checked as a file' is loose: File.exist? also passes a directory, and candidates are tried with configured extensions.
